description: Product administrators only: map an external referrer domain to a source and channel in Arroway's acquisition view, when an administrator asks. Stores only the domain and two labels; calling again replaces the mapping.

channel.description: Short channel label, such as organic-social or directory.

domain.description: External hostname only, such as linkedin.com.

source.description: Short source label, such as linkedin.

name: arroway_configure_referrer
title: Configure a known acquisition referrer
